svg.title: Automatic notifications: one event, guarded device delivery
svg.desc: The original Home Assistant notification runs first. An explicitly selected copy reaches the existing gateway through a separate event consumer. Private source and device rules, durable duplicate prevention, freshness checks and device idle checks guard Cisco text screens and optional direct Echo speech. Offline or busy devices are skipped without replay or SIP fallback.
svg.text: One notification. The right devices.
Existing Home Assistant delivery first · explicitly selected local copies
01 / ORIGINAL DELIVERY
Home Assistant notification
Keep mobile, browser and TV routes.
A failed optional copy cannot block them.
02 / OPT-IN COPY
also_devices → separate event consumer
Original event ID + time + source category + title + message
One copy per event · separate from also_chrome · no retry loop
03 / EXISTING GATEWAY · POST /v1/notifications
Private routing + durable claims before delivery
Allowed sources · physical-device deduplication · event expiry · cooldown · fresh device state
No message text in delivery history
04A / CISCO SCREEN
Idle text notification
One physical handset · app idle timeout
Skip offline, busy, DND or active-alert devices.
04B / CONVERTED ECHO
Optional direct announcement
Configured HA voice · speech opt-in · quiet hours
Atomic idle guard · no fallback SIP call
Missed or uncertain delivery is not replayed. No call interruption, microphone activation or delayed catch-up.
